tolerance_notes: cumulative returns are published to 2 decimals (+/-0.005 pp); CAGR also depends on the unstated day-count convention (+/-0.02 pp); the difference is always reported. The since-inception figure is not checked: our series starts later than the index. Nifty India Defence 5-year CAGR (47.32%): tolerance 0.03 pp, accepted by the owner on 2026-11-13. At this growth rate the unstated day-count convention alone moves the figure by about 0.04 pp (365 vs 365.25 days), and the other four checks agree to 0.004 pp.
